strengths: Correctly kills ‘in Japan, bikes belong on the sidewalk.’
Lists the standard exception cluster: signs, under 13, 70+, disability, unavoidable safety.
States sidewalk remains pedestrian-first: slow, roadway side, yield.
Sports cyclists on the roadway vs shopping mamachari: subcultures, not one national bike personality.

issues.location: Visitor Tips — walking ‘keep right or left’
issues.problem: Could be misread as a Japanese sidewalk keep-side rule. The sentence hedges with predictability, but visitors may import UK/JP roadway myths.
issues.suggestion: ‘Be predictable; there is no reliable bike rail on the sidewalk.’
